name: docker-sandboxes-kits
description: Use this skill when authoring, verifying, publishing, or composing a Docker Sandboxes kit, even if the user just says they want to "add a tool to a sandbox agent", "package a CLI or agent as a kit", "publish a kit to a registry", or "give a mixin its own credentials and network access". Covers the v3 kit descriptor (`# syntax=docker/sandbox-kit:3`, `kind: workload` or `mixin`, typed capabilities, provides/requires, content recipes), building with docker buildx, checking with kit-tck and `sbx kit inspect`, composing onto a workload, referencing and pinning a kit from an `sbxenv.yaml` `agent:`/`kits:` entry, and publishing and signing. Legacy v2 `spec.yaml` kits are not covered; `sbx kit validate` is not a substitute for kit-tck conformance and runtime checks.
